title: M08 — CRDs & Operators — Baseline
description: Tour a working operator on the Polyphone fleet: a MediaTenant CustomResourceDefinition that extends the API, two MediaTenant custom resources, and the tenant-operator control loop that reconciles each into a child media Deployment, stamps an ownerReference back to the CR, and reports progress in .status.

steps.title: The CRD: a new type in the API
Custom resources: spec you set, status the operator writes
The operator reconciling: reading operator-managed state
Owner references: the chain cascading deletion follows
